subject: English
passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
• Some historic murals in downtown buildings have been damaged by water infiltration and air pollution.
• Art conservators can remove deteriorated sections using chemical solvents.
• For delicate pigments, chemical treatment is not always feasible because it can cause discoloration or complete paint loss.
• Art conservators can use a laser cleaning technique, which involves using controlled light pulses to remove contaminants.
• This technique is highly precise.
prompt: The student wants to explain an advantage of the laser cleaning technique. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

choices.A: Removing contaminants with controlled light pulses is more precise than using chemical solvents, which can cause discoloration or complete paint loss on delicate pigments.
choices.B: To restore historic murals in downtown buildings, chemical treatment is not always feasible.
choices.C: Art conservators can use chemical solvents to remove deteriorated sections or apply controlled light pulses to remove contaminants.
choices.D: As methods for restoring historic murals, chemical treatment and laser cleaning differ in their level of precision.

explanation:
Choice A is the best answer. The sentence effectively explains an advantage of laser cleaning: it's more precise than using chemical solvents.

Why C is incorrect:

Choice C is incorrect. The sentence identifies the two techniques art conservators use; it doesn't explain an advantage of laser cleaning.
